|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E3 (version 4 of 5) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Han, Chewie, And The Falcon (V) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V5-L-Han_Chewie_And_The_Falcon_(V)-2023-12-11-errata-slip.png]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V5-L-Han_Chewie_And_The_Falcon_(V)-2023-12-11-errata-slip-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V5-L-Han_Chewie_And_The_Falcon_(V)-2023-08-16-53572eb.png]], 16 August 2023) → [[File:V5-L-Han_Chewie_And_The_Falcon_(V)-2023-12-11-errata-slip-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V5-L-Han_Chewie_And_The_Falcon_(V)-2023-12-11-errata-slip.png]], 11 December 2023). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E2”, but this is errata 3 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Han, Chewie, And The Falcon (V)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-hanchewieandthefalco022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/hanchewieandthefalcon.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual5-Light/large/hanchewieandthefalcon.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Han, Chewie, And The ''Falcon''”. Text: “Permanent pilots are •Han and •Chewie, who provide total ability of 5. Attempts here to “blow away” any Death Star are +2. Immune to Come With Me, Lateral Damage, Life Debt, and attrition < 6.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Han, Chewie, And The Falcon (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 12 May 2020<ref name="img-hanchewieandthefalcoa5142dd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/hanchewieandthefalcon.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 commit a5142dd] (12 May 2020); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual5-Light/large/hanchewieandthefalcon.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the game text was rewritten (compare the texts below); the errata mark “E” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); the bottom margin “•Han, Chewie, And The ''Falcon''” → “Han, Chewie, And The ''Falcon''” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “Han, Chewie, And The ''Falcon''”. Text: “May add 2 passengers. Permanent pilots are •Han and •Chewie, who provide total ability of 5. While in battle, adds one destiny to total power. Immune to Come With Me, Life Debt, and attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Han, Chewie, And The Falcon (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 16 August 2023<ref name="img-hanchewieandthefalco53572eb">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/hanchewieandthefalcon.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/53572eb94d14c4f21f0f3396874727653397c6e8 commit 53572eb] (16 August 2023); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual5-Light/large/hanchewieandthefalcon.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the errata mark “E” → “E1”; the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Han, Chewie, And The ''Falcon''”. Text: “May add 2 passengers. Permanent pilots are •Han and •Chewie, who provide total ability of 5. While in battle, adds one destiny to total power. Immune to Come With Me, Life Debt, and attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): PC errata sheet slip (Errata-12-2023.pdf, page 1), PDF dated 11 December 2023<ref name="slip-hcf-122023">Players Committee errata sheet [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Errata-12-2023.pdf#page=1 Errata-12-2023.pdf], page 1; the date is the PDF's creation date (11 December 2023).</ref>. '''What changed:''' “May add 2 passengers. Permanent pilots” → “Permanent pilots”; “attrition < 5.” → “attrition < 6.”; the errata mark “E1” → “E2”; a different printing: the errata sheet slip (printed for sleeving over the card) replaces the card image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E2”; bottom margin “Han, Chewie, And The ''Falcon''”. Text: “Permanent pilots are •Han and •Chewie, who provide total ability of 5. While in battle, adds one destiny to total power. Immune to Come With Me, Life Debt, and attrition < 6.”
